definitions.explanation: To stop walking or moving and remain standing in one place.
To stop and think or reconsider (figurative use).

notes:
{立|た}ち{止|ど}まる is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to stop or halt.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ (to stand) + ⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧ (to stop) → to stop while standing

ASPECT (ている):
{立|た}ち{止|ど}まって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates a state of standing still.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{思|おも}わず→思わず：02549_omowazu⟧{立|た}ち{止|ど}まる (stop involuntarily)
- ⟦ふと→ふと：00048_futo⟧{立|た}ち{止|ど}まる (suddenly stop)
- ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{止|と}める→止める：00678_tomeru⟧: similar meaning, more literary

USAGE:
Used metaphorically to describe pausing in life to think, reflect, or reconsider one's direction.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{止|と}まる→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧: to stop (more general)
- {立|た}ち{止|ど}まる specifically implies stopping while on foot
